title: Jesus... Is It Wrong That I Feel This Proud?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, is it wrong that I feel this proud?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I worked two years for this and it finally happened.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. I am glad. Why do you assume I am not?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Because people keep saying stay humble.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Humility is not pretending it did not happen. It is remembering who carried you while it did.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Enjoy it loudly. Just do not start measuring people by it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: That is the part I am scared of.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Good. That fear is honest. Pride goes wrong when it needs someone beneath it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: How do I keep it clean?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Say thank you more than you say I did it. Lift someone next. I honour that in My time, and I am honouring it now.

bible.text: In the same way, you who are younger, submit yourselves to your elders. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.” Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.
